question: In 2025, the Central government selected which of the following start-ups to build India’s first indigenous artificial intelligence (AI) large language model (LLM)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarvam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sarvam** was selected by the Central Government in 2025 to create India's first indigenous artificial intelligence (AI) large language model (LLM).
 
• The initiative aims to build an AI-powered LLM to enable India to achieve technological self-reliance in the field of artificial intelligence.
 
• Sarvam focuses on developing AI systems that are tailored to Indian languages, cultural contexts, and unique societal needs.
 
• The project aligns with India's vision for **Aatmanirbhar Bharat** (self-reliant India) in the digital and AI domain.
 
• The platform will integrate cutting-edge technologies such as natural language processing (NLP), machine learning (ML), and neural networks to support diverse industries like healthcare, education, and governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sarvana**

 
 
• Sarvana is a fictional or hypothetical name in this context and does not represent any known AI-related startup or initiative.
 
• It is not associated with any government-backed project in the AI domain.
 
 
 
• **Srijan**
 
 
• Srijan refers to various initiatives or organizations in India, primarily in the context of innovation and development.
 
• It is not directly linked to AI development or large language models.
 
• However, the term "Srijan" is often used for projects focused on technology, entrepreneurship, and skill development.
 
 
 
• **Sarvshresht**
 
 
• Sarvshresht, meaning "the best" in Hindi, is a name that symbolizes excellence.
 
• Currently, no credible information links Sarvshresht to AI-related startups or the development of LLMs.
 
• The name could potentially represent future initiatives in India's technological advancements.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Large Language Models (LLMs) are advanced AI systems capable of processing and generating human-like text. Examples include GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) models developed by OpenAI.
 
• India's focus on indigenous LLMs stems from its need to address unique linguistic diversity, cultural requirements, and data security concerns.
 
• Such projects represent a critical step in strengthening India's position in the global AI landscape while promoting research and development within the country.
